summary: Medical chatbot application with expanded knowledge base including general health topics and women's health issues (menstruation, pregnancy, etc.)

existing_features.title: Expand the medical knowledge base in frontend/src/components/assistant/medicalKnowledgeBase.ts to include comprehensive information about menstrual periods, including normal cycle characteristics, common symptoms, when periods are irregular, and when to seek medical care

Add detailed information about the menstrual cycle phases to the medical knowledge base, covering follicular phase, ovulation, luteal phase, and menstruation with associated hormonal changes and typical symptoms

Add comprehensive pregnancy information to the medical knowledge base including early signs, trimesters overview, common symptoms, prenatal care guidance, warning signs, and when to seek immediate medical attention

Add information about common women's health conditions to the medical knowledge base including PCOS (Polycystic Ovary Syndrome), endometriosis, PMS (Premenstrual Syndrome), and menopause with symptoms, management approaches, and when to consult a healthcare provider

new_feature_requests.summary: Add women's health topics: periods, menstruation cycle, pregnancy information
